issues.legal_issue: Government agreements are validly executed when the officials who sign them are authorized to execute that kind of agreement on the government’s behalf.
material_facts: The disputes arose from three forest leases containing arbitration clauses, from which the company had obtained benefits.
A government notification authorized specified forest officials, including Conservators of Forests, to execute agreements relating to forest leases on the government’s behalf.
The Conservator of Forests signed the leases after that notification took effect.
Earlier rules concerning authority to sanction or cancel leases dealt with a matter distinct from authority to execute formal lease documents.
issues.conclusion: The leases were validly executed by duly authorized officials, so the disputes could be referred to arbitration under their arbitration clauses; the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 122(1) of the Jammu and Kashmir Constitution, corresponding to Article 299(1) of the Constitution of India, governs formal execution of government contracts. Authority to sanction or cancel an agreement is distinct from authority to execute it; a government order specifically authorizing officers to execute the relevant kind of agreement satisfies the execution requirement. A duly executed document is the best evidence of sanction. The Court applied Mulamchand v. State of Madhya Pradesh, [1968] 3 S.C.R. 214, concerning the purpose of formal execution requirements, and upheld referral under the arbitration clauses in applications under section 20 of the Jammu and Kashmir Arbitration Act, 2002.

rule.if: challenge_to_state_contract_execution and agreement_for_public_forest_lease and government_official_signed_agreement and government_authorization_covers_agreement_type

predicates.challenge_to_state_contract_execution: A party to a proceeding challenging the formal execution of a government agreement disputes whether it was properly executed on the government’s behalf.
predicates.agreement_for_public_forest_lease: The agreement concerns a lease of public forest resources.
predicates.government_official_signed_agreement: A government official signed the agreement on the government’s behalf.
predicates.government_authorization_covers_agreemen: A government authorization empowered that official to execute agreements of the kind at issue.

issues.definition: When a proceeding challenges execution of a government forest-lease agreement, and an authorized government official signed an agreement covered by the authorization, the agreement is treated as validly executed.
